record.paper_title: Selected Conjectures and Open Problems on Directed Graphs
record.original_question: For every n-vertex finite digraph D with sink set S, does D have a quasi-kernel Q satisfying |Q| <= (n + |S| - |N_D^-(S)|)/2, where N_D^-(S) is the set of vertices with arcs into S?

evidence.quote: In [53], Kostochka et al. gave an equivalent conjecture for all digraphs.
Conjecture 6.2 Let D be an n-vertex digraph, and let S be the set of sinks of D. Then D has a quasi-kernel Q such that |Q| ≤ n + |S| − |N − D (S)| 2 .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D=(V,A)$ be a finite digraph with $n=|V|$ vertices. A vertex $v\in V$ is called a sink of $D$ if it has no out-neighbors in $D$; denote by $S\subseteq V$ the set of all sinks of $D$. For a set $X\subseteq V$, let $N_D^{-}(X)=\{u\in V : \exists\, x\in X \text{ with } (u,x)\in A\}$ denote the set of in-neighbors of $X$. A subset $Q\subseteq V$ is a quasi-kernel of $D$ if (i) $Q$ is independent (no two vertices of $Q$ are joined by an arc in either direction), and (ii) every vertex of $V\setminus Q$ can be reached from some vertex of $Q$ by a directed path of length at most $2$.

Prove or disprove: every finite digraph $D$ on $n$ vertices possesses a quasi-kernel $Q$ satisfying
$$|Q| \;\le\; \frac{n + |S| - |N_D^{-}(S)|}{2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: This is a strengthening (by Kostochka et al.) of the long-standing Erdős–Székely small quasi-kernel conjecture, which remains open in general. Recent surveys (2023–2025) describe it as unresolved, with progress only for special digraph classes (quasi-transitive, semicomplete multipartite, unicyclic orientations, etc.) and via variant formulations.

status_evidence.title: On the Small Quasi-kernel conjecture — a survey
status_evidence.snippet: The small QK conjecture ... is still wide open. Proved only for a few special classes.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Towards the Small Quasi-Kernel Conjecture (Kostochka, Luo, Shan)
status_evidence.snippet: Kostochka et al. formulate an equivalent stronger conjecture for all digraphs involving the set of sinks S and N^-(S).
status_evidence.claim: The bound in question is exactly Kostochka et al.'s general-digraph reformulation.

status_evidence.title: A variable version of the quasi-kernel conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Develops variant conjectures; the small QK conjecture remains unresolved in full generality.
status_evidence.claim: As of 2024–2025 the conjecture is still open.
